statements: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `health_import_batches` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `received_at_ms` INTEGER NOT NULL, `imported_at_ms` INTEGER NOT NULL, `source_system` TEXT NOT NULL, `source_language` TEXT, `source_ref` TEXT, `source_hash` TEXT, `author` TEXT NOT NULL, `notes` TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(`id`))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_health_import_batches_source_hash` ON `health_import_batches` (`source_hash`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `health_source_metadata` (`owner_kind` TEXT NOT NULL, `owner_id` TEXT NOT NULL, `key` TEXT NOT NULL, `value` TEXT NOT NULL, `source_label` TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(`owner_kind`, `owner_id`, `key`))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `health_events` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `import_batch_id` TEXT, `event_kind` TEXT NOT NULL, `occurred_at_ms` INTEGER, `utc_offset_min` INTEGER, `time_precision` TEXT NOT NULL, `title_it` TEXT, `place_id` TEXT, `clinician_contact_id` INTEGER, `source_system` TEXT NOT NULL, `source_ref` TEXT, `created_at_ms` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updated_at_ms` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`id`), FOREIGN KEY(`import_batch_id`) REFERENCES `health_import_batches`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE SET NULL, FOREIGN KEY(`place_id`) REFERENCES `places`(`uuid`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE SET NULL, FOREIGN KEY(`clinician_contact_id`) REFERENCES `contacts`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE SET NULL)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_health_events_import_batch_id` ON `health_events` (`import_batch_id`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_health_events_place_id` ON `health_events` (`place_id`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_health_events_clinician_contact_id` ON `health_events` (`clinician_contact_id`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `health_samples` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `event_id` TEXT NOT NULL, `sample_kind` TEXT NOT NULL, `material_it` TEXT, `body_site_it` TEXT, `collection_ref` TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(`id`), FOREIGN KEY(`event_id`) REFERENCES `health_events`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_health_samples_event_id` ON `health_samples` (`event_id`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `health_examinations` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `canonical_name` TEXT NOT NULL, `display_name_it` TEXT NOT NULL, `category_it` TEXT NOT NULL, `default_unit` TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(`id`))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_health_examinations_canonical_name` ON `health_examinations` (`canonical_name`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `health_measurements` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `sample_id` TEXT NOT NULL, `examination_id` TEXT NOT NULL, `numeric_value` REAL, `text_value` TEXT, `unit` TEXT, `interpretation_it` TEXT, `flag` TEXT, `result_available_at_ms` INTEGER, `received_at_ms` INTEGER, `availability_basis` TEXT NOT NULL, `source_ref` TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(`id`), FOREIGN KEY(`sample_id`) REFERENCES `health_samples`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY(`examination_id`) REFERENCES `health_examinations`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE RESTRICT)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_health_measurements_sample_id` ON `health_measurements` (`sample_id`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_health_measurements_examination_id` ON `health_measurements` (`examination_id`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `health_journal_entries` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `event_id` TEXT NOT NULL, `authored_at_ms` INTEGER, `authored_utc_offset_min` INTEGER, `authored_time_precision` TEXT, `encounter_type_it` TEXT, `department_it` TEXT, `clinician_role_it` TEXT, `note_type_it` TEXT, `title_it` TEXT, `text_it` TEXT NOT NULL, `original_text_da` TEXT NOT NULL, `source_ref` TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(`id`), FOREIGN KEY(`event_id`) REFERENCES `health_events`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_health_journal_entries_event_id` ON `health_journal_entries` (`event_id`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `health_ai_snapshots` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `subject_kind` TEXT NOT NULL, `subject_id` TEXT NOT NULL, `as_of_ms` INTEGER NOT NULL, `generated_at_ms` INTEGER NOT NULL, `generated_by` TEXT NOT NULL, `model` TEXT, `assessment_version` INTEGER NOT NULL, `stance` TEXT, `comment_it` TEXT NOT NULL, `uncertainty_it` TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(`id`))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_health_ai_snapshots_subject_kind_subject_id` ON `health_ai_snapshots` (`subject_kind`, `subject_id`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `health_ai_evidence` (`snapshot_id` TEXT NOT NULL, `evidence_kind` TEXT NOT NULL, `evidence_id` TEXT NOT NULL, `relevance_it` TEXT NOT NULL, `position` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`snapshot_id`, `evidence_kind`, `evidence_id`), FOREIGN KEY(`snapshot_id`) REFERENCES `health_ai_snapshots`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_health_ai_evidence_snapshot_id` ON `health_ai_evidence` (`snapshot_id`)

CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS `v_health_measurement_turnaround` AS SELECT m.id AS measurement_id,m.sample_id,e.occurred_at_ms AS collection_ms,COALESCE(m.result_available_at_ms,m.received_at_ms) AS received_ms,CASE WHEN s.sample_kind='blood' AND e.time_precision='datetime' AND COALESCE(m.result_available_at_ms,m.received_at_ms)>=e.occurred_at_ms THEN COALESCE(m.result_available_at_ms,m.received_at_ms)-e.occurred_at_ms END AS delta_ms,m.availability_basis FROM health_measurements m JOIN health_samples s ON s.id=m.sample_id JOIN health_events e ON e.id=s.event_id

CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS `v_health_sample_turnaround` AS SELECT sample_id,MIN(delta_ms) AS first_ms,MAX(delta_ms) AS last_ms,AVG(delta_ms) AS mean_ms,COUNT(delta_ms) AS result_count FROM v_health_measurement_turnaround GROUP BY sample_id

CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS `v_health_turnaround_stats` AS SELECT COUNT(delta_ms) AS result_count,AVG(delta_ms) AS mean_ms,MIN(delta_ms) AS min_ms,MAX(delta_ms) AS max_ms FROM v_health_measurement_turnaround

CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS `v_health_samples` AS SELECT s.id AS sample_id,e.occurred_at_ms AS data_ms,s.sample_kind,e.title_it AS title,COUNT(m.id) AS result_count,SUM(CASE WHEN m.flag IS NOT NULL AND m.flag<>'' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abnormal_count,a.comment_it AS ai_comment FROM health_samples s JOIN health_events e ON e.id=s.event_id LEFT JOIN health_measurements m ON m.sample_id=s.id LEFT JOIN health_ai_snapshots a ON a.subject_kind='sample' AND a.subject_id=s.id GROUP BY s.id

CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS `v_health_measurements` AS SELECT m.*,x.display_name_it AS examination_name,x.category_it,e.occurred_at_ms AS data_ms,a.comment_it AS ai_comment FROM health_measurements m JOIN health_examinations x ON x.id=m.examination_id JOIN health_samples s ON s.id=m.sample_id JOIN health_events e ON e.id=s.event_id LEFT JOIN health_ai_snapshots a ON a.subject_kind='measurement' AND a.subject_id=m.id
CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS `v_health_sample_measurements` AS SELECT * FROM v_health_measurements

CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS `v_health_journal` AS SELECT j.*,e.occurred_at_ms AS data_ms,e.place_id,e.clinician_contact_id,a.stance AS ai_stance,a.comment_it AS ai_comment,a.uncertainty_it AS ai_uncertainty FROM health_journal_entries j JOIN health_events e ON e.id=j.event_id LEFT JOIN health_ai_snapshots a ON a.subject_kind='journal' AND a.subject_id=j.id
CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS `v_health_ai_evidence` AS SELECT a.subject_kind,a.subject_id,e.* FROM health_ai_evidence e JOIN health_ai_snapshots a ON a.id=e.snapshot_id

CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS `v_health_timeline` AS SELECT e.occurred_at_ms AS data_ms,'sample' AS kind,s.id AS entity_id,COALESCE(e.title_it,'Campione') AS title,s.material_it AS subtitle,NULL AS value,NULL AS unit,NULL AS flag,s.id AS sample_id,e.place_id,e.clinician_contact_id,a.stance AS ai_stance,a.comment_it AS ai_comment FROM health_samples s JOIN health_events e ON e.id=s.event_id LEFT JOIN health_ai_snapshots a ON a.subject_kind='sample' AND a.subject_id=s.id UNION ALL SELECT e.occurred_at_ms,'measurement',m.id,x.display_name_it,x.category_it,COALESCE(CAST(m.numeric_value AS TEXT),m.text_value,m.interpretation_it),m.unit,m.flag,m.sample_id,e.place_id,e.clinician_contact_id,a.stance,a.comment_it FROM health_measurements m JOIN health_examinations x ON x.id=m.examination_id JOIN health_samples s ON s.id=m.sample_id JOIN health_events e ON e.id=s.event_id LEFT JOIN health_ai_snapshots a ON a.subject_kind='measurement' AND a.subject_id=m.id UNION ALL SELECT e.occurred_at_ms,'journal',j.id,COALESCE(j.title_it,e.title_it,'Nota clinica'),j.department_it,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,e.place_id,e.clinician_contact_id,a.stance,a.comment_it FROM health_journal_entries j JOIN health_events e ON e.id=j.event_id LEFT JOIN health_ai_snapshots a ON a.subject_kind='journal' AND a.subject_id=j.id
